Public read-only Equidia API MCP server and CLI.

- 60 API routes, 11 aliases and offline discovery; no Equidia credentials required.
- MCP stdio and Streamable HTTP, TLS/mTLS, protected metrics and container deployment.
- Native executables for Linux and macOS on x86_64 and ARM64, with SHA-256 checksums.
- Multi-platform GHCR image for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64.

See `docs/release.md` for installation, container tags and publishing details.
Source code is MIT licensed; API data and media remain subject to their owners' rights.
